# NexPlay — Nepal's Esports Tournament & Scrim Platform

> NexPlay is the premier esports platform for Nepal, offering tournament hosting, daily scrims, secure wallet-based entry systems, real-time leaderboards, and team management for PUBG Mobile, Free Fire, Valorant, and Mobile Legends. www.nexplayorg.app serves Nepali gamers with free-to-enter daily scrims, premium refereed tournaments, and a national ranking system.

## Core Pages

- [Tournaments](https://www.nexplayorg.app/tournaments): Browse and register for active esports tournaments in Nepal
- [Scrims](https://www.nexplayorg.app/scrims): Join daily practice scrims for PUBG Mobile, Free Fire, and more
- [Games](https://www.nexplayorg.app/games): Explore supported esports titles and their competitive modes
- [Organizations](https://www.nexplayorg.app/organizations): Discover esports organizations and gaming teams in Nepal
- [Leaderboard](https://www.nexplayorg.app/leaderboard): National esports rankings and player statistics
- [Teams](https://www.nexplayorg.app/teams): Browse competitive esports teams in Nepal
- [News](https://www.nexplayorg.app/news): Esports news, updates, and community content

## About

- [About NexPlay](https://www.nexplayorg.app/about): Mission, team, and platform overview
- [Contact](https://www.nexplayorg.app/contact): Get in touch with the NexPlay team
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.nexplayorg.app/privacy): Data handling and privacy commitments
- [Terms of Service](https://www.nexplayorg.app/terms): Platform rules and user agreements

## Games Supported

- PUBG Mobile tournaments and scrims in Nepal
- Free Fire tournaments and scrims in Nepal
- Valorant tournaments in Nepal
- Mobile Legends tournaments in Nepal

## Key Features

- Secure wallet-based tournament entry with escrow protection
- Admin-refereed tournament brackets and scoring
- Real-time national leaderboard rankings
- Team registration and roster management
- Daily free scrim matchmaking
- Tournament result tracking and match history

## Audience & Region

NexPlay serves the Nepali esports community. Content is in English. GEO target: Nepal (NP).
